Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUJ Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts at Central University of Jharkhand is 23rd August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position in Economics at the Central University of Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post-Graduate degree in Economics with at least 55% marks, a B.Ed. degree with 55% marks, and NET or Ph.D. in Education or the concerned subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 55,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the CUJ Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CUJ Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Central University of Jharkhand located?
faq.answer: The Central University of Jharkhand is located in Ranchi, Jharkhand, with the pincode 835222.

faq.question: Q9. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts is scheduled for 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online only. Offline applications will not be accepted.
